contracts: SceneResource_LoadSharedC000AndPrepareFrame loads SCENE_SHARED_C000_GRAPHICS to C000 and prepares its shared palette frame for four direct presentation wrappers.
The state-01 primary and secondary wrappers select the corresponding C000 graphics and presentation streams with fixed interpreter parameter pairs.

The state-00, state-03, state-05 primary/secondary, state-07, and state-0B wrappers select the canonical shared/state-specific C000 resource and state presentation stream recorded in the ROM dispatcher.
limitations: These names identify exact wrapper state/resource/stream contracts; they do not claim that every presentation state has been reached by a natural runtime route.
Blank-frame wrapper families remain separately named because their shared blank resource and stream roles are distinct.
The legacy source-address names remain aliases for historical findings and downstream references.
conclusion: Nine scene presentation wrappers and their shared C000 loader now have stable state and resource identities while preserving exact stream parameters and legacy aliases.
